newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to auction 4-year notes next week -- traders.
newsitem.headline: Japan to auction 4-year notes next week -- traders.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) is likely to offer four-year government notes in a price-competitive auction next week, traders said on Friday.
They said the offer volume was likely to be 400 billion yen instead of 500 billion in previous issues.
When it last issued six-year government bonds on July 1, MOF cut the volume to 400 billion yen from 500 billion in previous issues.
When the MOF last auctioned four-year notes on May 27, it offered 500 billion yen worth of 1.7 percent notes. -- Tokyo Treasury Desk +81-3-3432-8570
